The Hebrew has the divine name YHWH where the Greek has "Lord". Hebrews quotes freely: "This" for "Look", "God" for "the Lord", and "commanded" for "made". "This is the blood of the covenant" also echoes Jesus's words over the cup at the Last Supper (Mark 14:24; Matthew 26:28).

decisions.choice: water, scarlet wool, hyssop, and the sprinkling of the book: details gathered from other rites of the law
decisions.reason: Exodus 24 mentions only the blood of young bulls sprinkled on the altar and the people. Water, scarlet wool and hyssop belong to the rites for cleansing a healed skin disease (Leviticus 14:4-7) and to the red heifer water (Numbers 19:6, 19:18); hyssop was used to put the Passover blood on the doors (Exodus 12:22). The author draws these rites together, and adds the sprinkling of the book, which Exodus does not mention.

decisions.choice: the calves
decisions.reason: The SBLGNT reads "the calves". Many manuscripts read "the calves and the goats", which may have come in from 9:12 and 9:13; other early witnesses, including P46, have the shorter text. Reviewers must check this note against the apparatus.

decisions.choice: that God commanded to you: the covenant God laid on you as his ordinance
decisions.reason: ἐνετείλατο means to command or give orders. The covenant at Sinai was God's arrangement, given with its commands (24:3, 24:7), not an agreement between equals.

decisions.choice: book (Literal, Balanced), book of the law (Readable)
decisions.reason: βιβλίον was a scroll, but Exodus 24:7 calls it "the book of the covenant", and "book" is kept. Readable adds "of the law" so the reader knows which book.

decisions.choice: that God has set up for you by his command
decisions.reason: Readable unpacks "commanded to you": God set up the covenant and gave it as his command.

decisions.choice: passé simple (Literal, Balanced), passé composé (Readable) for the narrative of 9:19-21
decisions.reason: Verses 19-21 tell what Moses did at Sinai. As the French style guide sets out, written narrative is in the passé simple at Literal and Balanced ("il aspergea") and in the passé composé at Readable ("il a aspergé"), which is how French is read in school today. The argument around it stays in the present and the passé composé at every level.

source.text: καὶ τὴν σκηνὴν δὲ καὶ πάντα τὰ σκεύη τῆς λειτουργίας τῷ αἵματι ὁμοίως ἐράντισεν.

records.literal_gloss: And the tent also, and all the vessels of the ministry, with the blood likewise he sprinkled.

en.L: And he likewise sprinkled with the blood the tent too and all the vessels of the ministry.
en.B: Likewise he sprinkled blood on the tabernacle as well, and on all the vessels used in its worship.
en.R: In the same way he sprinkled the blood on the sacred tent and on all the things used in its worship.

es.L: Y también la tienda y todos los utensilios del ministerio los roció igualmente con la sangre.
es.B: Del mismo modo roció con sangre también el tabernáculo y todos los utensilios que se usaban en su culto.
es.R: De la misma manera roció la sangre sobre la tienda sagrada y sobre todas las cosas que se usaban en su adoración.

fr.L: Et il aspergea de même avec le sang la tente aussi et tous les objets du service.
fr.B: De même, il aspergea de sang le tabernacle aussi, et tous les objets servant au culte.
fr.R: De la même façon, il a aspergé de sang la tente sacrée et tous les objets qui servaient au culte.

sw.L: Na hema pia, na vyombo vyote vya huduma, vivyo hivyo alivinyunyizia damu.
sw.B: Vivyo hivyo alinyunyiza damu juu ya hema pia, na juu ya vyombo vyote vilivyotumika katika ibada yake.
sw.R: Kwa njia hiyo hiyo alinyunyiza damu juu ya hema takatifu na juu ya vitu vyote vilivyotumika katika ibada yake.

decisions.choice: he sprinkled the tent and its vessels with blood: the author sums up the blood rites of the tabernacle
decisions.reason: The tabernacle was built after the covenant meal of Exodus 24, and Exodus describes its dedication with anointing oil (Exodus 40:9-11). Blood was put on the altar when the priests were ordained (Leviticus 8:15, 8:19), and on the Day of Atonement it was sprinkled on the mercy seat and the altar to cleanse the sanctuary (Leviticus 16:14-19). The author gathers these rites under Moses, who began them.

decisions.choice: the vessels of the ministry: the utensils and furnishings used in the priests' service
decisions.reason: λειτουργίας is priestly service (the same word in 8:6). The vessels are the bowls, basins and other things used in it (Exodus 25:29; 27:3).

source.text: καὶ σχεδὸν ἐν αἵματι πάντα καθαρίζεται κατὰ τὸν νόμον, καὶ χωρὶς αἱματεκχυσίας οὐ γίνεται ἄφεσις.

records.literal_gloss: And almost with blood all things are cleansed according to the law, and without blood-shedding not occurs forgiveness.

en.L: And almost all things are cleansed with blood according to the law, and apart from shedding of blood there is no forgiveness.
en.B: The law, in fact, has almost everything made clean with blood, and where no blood is shed there is no forgiveness.
en.R: The law says that almost everything must be made clean with blood. If no blood is poured out, sins are not forgiven.

es.L: Y casi todas las cosas son purificadas con sangre según la ley, y sin derramamiento de sangre no hay perdón.
es.B: De hecho, según la ley casi todo se purifica con sangre, y donde no se derrama sangre no hay perdón.
es.R: La ley dice que casi todo tiene que quedar limpio por medio de sangre. Si no se derrama sangre, los pecados no son perdonados.

fr.L: Et presque toutes choses sont purifiées avec du sang selon la Loi, et sans effusion de sang le pardon n’a pas lieu.
fr.B: D’après la Loi, en effet, presque tout est purifié par le sang, et là où aucun sang n’est versé, il n’y a pas de pardon.
fr.R: La loi dit que presque tout doit être purifié avec du sang. Si on ne verse pas de sang, les péchés ne sont pas pardonnés.

sw.L: Na karibu vitu vyote husafishwa kwa damu kulingana na sheria, na bila kumwagwa kwa damu hakutokei msamaha.
sw.B: Kwa kweli, kwa mujibu wa sheria karibu kila kitu husafishwa kwa damu, na mahali ambapo damu haimwagwi hakuna msamaha.
sw.R: Sheria inasema kwamba karibu kila kitu lazima kisafishwe kwa damu. Damu isipomwagwa, dhambi hazisamehewi.

decisions.choice: almost all things: the law allowed a few other means of cleansing
decisions.reason: Some things were cleansed by water or fire (Numbers 31:22-24; Leviticus 15), and a very poor person could bring flour as a sin offering (Leviticus 5:11-13). So the author says "almost".

decisions.choice: shedding of blood: blood poured out in sacrifice, the giving up of a life
alternatives: only the pouring of blood at the altar
only the killing of the animal
decisions.reason: αἱματεκχυσίας is a rare compound, not found in earlier Greek writings that survive. It joins "blood" and "pouring out", and covers both the death of the sacrifice and the use of its blood. Behind it stands Leviticus 17:11: the life is in the blood, and God gave it on the altar to make atonement.

decisions.choice: forgiveness: release from sins
decisions.reason: ἄφεσις means release, and in the New Testament usually the forgiveness of sins; 10:18 uses it the same way. The object "sins" is understood.

decisions.choice: sins are not forgiven
decisions.reason: Readable names sins, which the Greek leaves understood.

source.text: Ἀνάγκη οὖν τὰ μὲν ὑποδείγματα τῶν ἐν τοῖς οὐρανοῖς τούτοις καθαρίζεσθαι, αὐτὰ δὲ τὰ ἐπουράνια κρείττοσι θυσίαις παρὰ ταύτας.

records.literal_gloss: Necessary then [for] the indeed copies of the [things] in the heavens with these to be cleansed, themselves but the heavenly [things] with better sacrifices than these.

en.L: [It was] necessary then for the copies of the things in the heavens to be cleansed with these, but the heavenly things themselves with better sacrifices than these.
en.B: The copies of what is in heaven, then, had to be cleansed in these ways; but the heavenly realities themselves required sacrifices better than these.
en.R: So the copies of the things in heaven had to be made clean by these sacrifices. But the real things in heaven needed better sacrifices than these.

es.L: [Era] necesario, pues, que las copias de las cosas en los cielos fueran purificadas con estas cosas, pero las cosas celestiales mismas con sacrificios mejores que estos.
es.B: Así pues, las copias de lo que está en el cielo tenían que ser purificadas de esta manera; pero las realidades celestiales mismas requerían sacrificios mejores que estos.
es.R: Por eso las copias de las cosas del cielo tenían que quedar limpias con estos sacrificios. Pero las cosas verdaderas del cielo necesitaban sacrificios mejores que estos.

fr.L: [Il était] donc nécessaire que les copies des choses [qui sont] dans les cieux soient purifiées par ceux-ci, mais les choses célestes elles-mêmes par des sacrifices meilleurs que ceux-là.
fr.B: Il fallait donc que les copies de ce qui est dans le ciel soient purifiées de cette manière ; mais les réalités célestes elles-mêmes demandaient des sacrifices meilleurs que ceux-là.
fr.R: Les copies des choses du ciel devaient donc être purifiées par ces sacrifices. Mais les vraies choses du ciel avaient besoin de sacrifices meilleurs que ceux-là.

sw.L: [Ilikuwa] lazima basi nakala za vitu vilivyo mbinguni zisafishwe kwa hivi, lakini vitu vya mbinguni vyenyewe kwa dhabihu zilizo bora kuliko hizi.
sw.B: Basi ilikuwa lazima nakala za vitu vilivyo mbinguni zisafishwe kwa njia hizo; lakini mambo halisi ya mbinguni yenyewe yalihitaji dhabihu zilizo bora kuliko hizo.
sw.R: Kwa hiyo nakala za vitu vilivyo mbinguni zilihitaji kusafishwa kwa dhabihu hizo. Lakini vitu halisi vilivyo mbinguni vilihitaji dhabihu zilizo bora kuliko hizo.

decisions.choice: copies: the earthly tabernacle and its furnishings, made after a heavenly pattern
decisions.reason: ὑποδείγματα means a copy or sketch. In 8:5 the author used it with "shadow" for the earthly sanctuary, made by the pattern shown to Moses on the mountain (Exodus 25:40).

decisions.choice: the heavenly things themselves had to be cleansed: the true sanctuary was prepared by Christ's sacrifice for sinful people to enter
alternatives: heaven itself was defiled by sin
the cleansing is of the consciences of God's people, who are his house (3:6)
decisions.reason: The author does not explain in what way heavenly things need cleansing. As the earthly tent was cleansed so that a holy God could live among an unclean people (Leviticus 16:16), the heavenly sanctuary is made ready by Christ's blood for sinners to approach God (10:19-22). The sense is reached through the parallel, and the author leaves it there.

decisions.choice: better sacrifices: the plural follows the plural of the copies; it means Christ's one sacrifice
alternatives: more than one sacrifice in heaven
decisions.reason: The author insists Christ offered one sacrifice once (9:26, 9:28; 10:12, 10:14). The plural sets the class of sacrifice against "these" animal sacrifices.

decisions.choice: with these: by these rites of blood, water and the rest just described
decisions.reason: τούτοις looks back to the rites of verses 19-22.

decisions.choice: heavenly realities
decisions.reason: Balanced says "realities" to bring out the contrast with "copies"; Literal keeps "heavenly things".

source.text: οὐ γὰρ εἰς χειροποίητα εἰσῆλθεν ἅγια Χριστός, ἀντίτυπα τῶν ἀληθινῶν, ἀλλ’ εἰς αὐτὸν τὸν οὐρανόν, νῦν ἐμφανισθῆναι τῷ προσώπῳ τοῦ θεοῦ ὑπὲρ ἡμῶν·

records.literal_gloss: Not for into made-with-hands entered holy [place] Christ, copies of the true [ones], but into itself the heaven, now to appear in the face of the God for us;

en.L: For {{christos:Christ|Messiah}} did not enter into a holy place made with hands, copies of the true [ones], but into heaven itself, now to appear before the face of God for us.
en.B: For it was not into a sanctuary made by hands, a copy of the real one, that {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} went. He went into heaven itself, and there {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} now appears before the face of God on our behalf.
en.R: For {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} did not go into a holy place that people had made. That was only a copy of the real one. He went into heaven itself. Now {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} appears before God for us.

es.L: Porque {{christos:Cristo|Mesías}} no entró en un lugar santo hecho por manos, copias de lo verdadero, sino en el cielo mismo, para presentarse ahora ante el rostro de Dios por nosotros.
es.B: Porque no fue en un santuario hecho por manos, copia del verdadero, donde entró {{christos:Cristo|el Mesías}}. Entró en el cielo mismo, y allí se presenta ahora ante el rostro de Dios a favor nuestro.
es.R: Porque {{christos:Cristo|el Mesías}} no entró en un lugar santo hecho por personas. Ese lugar era solo una copia del verdadero. Entró en el cielo mismo. Ahora se presenta ante Dios por nosotros.

fr.L: Car {{christos:Christ|le Messie}} n’est pas entré dans un lieu saint fait par des mains, copies des véritables, mais dans le ciel même, pour paraître maintenant devant la face de Dieu pour nous.
fr.B: Car ce n’est pas dans un sanctuaire fait par des mains, copie du véritable, que {{christos:Christ|le Messie}} est entré. Il est entré dans le ciel même, et là {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} paraît maintenant devant la face de Dieu en notre faveur.
fr.R: Car {{christos:Christ|le Messie}} n’est pas entré dans un lieu saint fait par des humains. Ce n’était qu’une copie du vrai. Il est entré dans le ciel lui-même. Maintenant, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} se présente devant Dieu pour nous.

sw.L: Kwa maana {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} hakuingia katika mahali patakatifu palipotengenezwa kwa mikono, nakala za vile vilivyo vya kweli, bali katika mbingu yenyewe, ili sasa ajitokeze mbele ya uso wa Mungu kwa niaba yetu.
sw.B: Kwa maana {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} hakuingia mahali patakatifu palipotengenezwa kwa mikono, nakala tu ya kile kilicho halisi. Aliingia mbinguni penyewe, na huko sasa anajitokeza mbele ya uso wa Mungu kwa niaba yetu.
sw.R: Kwa maana {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} hakuingia mahali patakatifu palipojengwa na watu. Mahali hapo palikuwa nakala tu ya mahali halisi. Aliingia mbinguni penyewe. Sasa anasimama mbele za Mungu kwa ajili yetu.

decisions.choice: copies of the true: a likeness that corresponds to the real thing
decisions.reason: ἀντίτυπα is a different word from the "copies" of 9:23. It means something made to correspond to an original, as an impression to a seal. The original, "the true", is the heavenly sanctuary (8:2).

decisions.choice: now to appear before God for us: Christ is in God's presence now, as our representative
decisions.reason: The high priest stood before God for the people once a year, hidden by incense (Leviticus 16:12-13). Christ appears openly in God's presence, and does so now and always, to speak for his people (7:25).

decisions.choice: copies
decisions.reason: Literal says "copies" for this word as for the word in 9:23, since "antitype" is a technical term most readers would not know; the meaning decision notes that the Greek words differ.

source.text: οὐδ’ ἵνα πολλάκις προσφέρῃ ἑαυτόν, ὥσπερ ὁ ἀρχιερεὺς εἰσέρχεται εἰς τὰ ἅγια κατ’ ἐνιαυτὸν ἐν αἵματι ἀλλοτρίῳ, ἐπεὶ ἔδει αὐτὸν πολλάκις παθεῖν ἀπὸ καταβολῆς κόσμου· νυνὶ δὲ ἅπαξ ἐπὶ συντελείᾳ τῶν αἰώνων εἰς ἀθέτησιν ἁμαρτίας διὰ τῆς θυσίας αὐτοῦ πεφανέρωται.

records.literal_gloss: nor that many times he should offer himself, just as the high priest enters into the holy [place] every year with blood belonging to another, \v 26 since it was necessary [for] him many times to suffer from foundation of world; now but once at completion of the ages for putting away of sin through the sacrifice of him he has been made manifest.

en.L: nor [did {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} enter] so that {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} might offer {{deity_pronoun:himself|Himself}} many times, just as the high priest enters into the holy place every year with blood not his own, \v 26 since then it would have been necessary for {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} to suffer many times from [the] foundation of [the] world. But now once at [the] completion of the ages {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has been made manifest for [the] putting away of sin through {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} sacrifice.
en.B: And {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} did not enter to offer {{deity_pronoun:himself|Himself}} repeatedly, as the high priest goes into the sanctuary each year with blood that belongs to another. \v 26 If that were so, {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} would have needed to suffer many times over, ever since the world was founded. Instead, {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has now been revealed once, when the ages reach their completion, to set sin aside through {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} sacrifice.
en.R: And {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} did not go in to offer {{deity_pronoun:himself|Himself}} again and again. The high priest goes into the Most Holy Place every year with blood that is not his own, the blood of animals. \v 26 If {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} had to do that, {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} would have had to suffer many times since the world began. But now, at the time when the ages reach their goal, {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has come once and only once. He came to take sin away by sacrificing {{deity_pronoun:himself|Himself}}.

es.L: ni [entró] para ofrecerse a {{deity_pronoun:sí mismo|Sí mismo}} muchas veces, como el sumo sacerdote entra en el lugar santo cada año con sangre ajena, \v 26 pues en ese caso habría sido necesario que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} sufriera muchas veces desde [la] fundación del mundo. Pero ahora, una sola vez, en [la] consumación de las edades, se ha manifestado para [la] anulación del pecado mediante {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} sacrificio.
es.B: Y no entró para ofrecerse a {{deity_pronoun:sí mismo|Sí mismo}} una y otra vez, como el sumo sacerdote entra en el santuario cada año con sangre ajena. \v 26 Si así fuera, habría tenido que sufrir muchas veces desde la fundación del mundo. Pero ahora se ha manifestado una sola vez, cuando las edades llegan a su consumación, para quitar de en medio el pecado mediante {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} sacrificio.
es.R: Y no entró para ofrecerse a {{deity_pronoun:sí mismo|Sí mismo}} una y otra vez. El sumo sacerdote entra en el Lugar Santísimo cada año con sangre que no es suya, la sangre de animales. \v 26 Si tuviera que hacer eso, habría tenido que sufrir muchas veces desde el principio del mundo. Pero ahora, en el tiempo en que las edades llegan a su meta, ha venido una vez, y solo una. Vino para quitar el pecado sacrificándose a {{deity_pronoun:sí mismo|Sí mismo}}.

fr.L: [et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} n’est] pas non plus [entré] pour s’offrir {{deity_pronoun:lui-même|Lui-même}} plusieurs fois, comme le grand prêtre entre dans le lieu saint chaque année avec un sang qui n’est pas le sien, \v 26 puisque alors il aurait fallu qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} souffre plusieurs fois depuis [la] fondation du monde. Mais maintenant, une seule fois, à [l’]achèvement des âges, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a été manifesté pour [l’]abolition du péché par {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} sacrifice.
fr.B: Et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} n’est pas entré pour s’offrir {{deity_pronoun:lui-même|Lui-même}} à plusieurs reprises, comme le grand prêtre entre chaque année dans le sanctuaire avec un sang qui appartient à un autre. \v 26 S’il en était ainsi, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} aurait dû souffrir bien des fois depuis la fondation du monde. Au contraire, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a maintenant été manifesté une seule fois, quand les âges arrivent à leur achèvement, pour annuler le péché par {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} sacrifice.
fr.R: Et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} n’est pas entré pour s’offrir {{deity_pronoun:lui-même|Lui-même}} encore et encore. Le grand prêtre entre dans le Lieu très saint chaque année avec un sang qui n’est pas le sien, le sang d’animaux. \v 26 Sinon, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} aurait dû souffrir bien des fois depuis le début du monde. Mais maintenant, au moment où les âges arrivent à leur but, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} est venu une fois, et une seule. Il est venu ôter le péché en se sacrifiant {{deity_pronoun:lui-même|Lui-même}}.

sw.L: wala [hakuingia] ili ajitoe {{deity_pronoun:mwenyewe|Mwenyewe}} mara nyingi, kama vile kuhani mkuu aingiavyo mahali patakatifu kila mwaka na damu isiyo yake, \v 26 kwa maana hapo ingemlazimu kuteswa mara nyingi tangu kuwekwa msingi wa ulimwengu. Lakini sasa mara moja katika ukamilisho wa zama amedhihirishwa kwa ajili ya kuibatilisha dhambi kwa dhabihu {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}.
sw.B: Wala hakuingia ili ajitoe {{deity_pronoun:mwenyewe|Mwenyewe}} tena na tena, kama kuhani mkuu aingiavyo mahali patakatifu kila mwaka na damu ya mwingine. \v 26 Kama ingekuwa hivyo, angelazimika kuteswa mara nyingi tangu ulimwengu ulipowekwa msingi. Badala yake, sasa amedhihirishwa mara moja, zama zinapofikia ukamilisho wake, ili kuiweka dhambi kando kwa dhabihu {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}.
sw.R: Tena hakuingia ili ajitoe {{deity_pronoun:mwenyewe|Mwenyewe}} tena na tena. Kuhani mkuu huingia Patakatifu pa Patakatifu kila mwaka akiwa na damu isiyo yake, yaani damu ya wanyama. \v 26 Kama ingempasa kufanya hivyo, angelazimika kuteseka mara nyingi tangu ulimwengu ulipoanza. Lakini sasa, wakati ambapo zama zinafikia lengo lake, amekuja mara moja tu, na si zaidi. Alikuja ili kuiondoa dhambi kwa kujitoa {{deity_pronoun:mwenyewe|Mwenyewe}} dhabihu.

decisions.choice: since it would have been necessary: an unreal condition; if his offering had to be repeated, so would his suffering
decisions.reason: ἐπεὶ with the past tense ἔδει states what would follow otherwise. A sacrifice of himself means a death; repeated offerings would have meant repeated deaths, ever since sin entered the world.

decisions.choice: at the completion of the ages: at the climax of history, the time God's purposes reach their goal
alternatives: at the end of the world
decisions.reason: συντελείᾳ means bringing to completion. "The ages" are the successive periods of history (1:2). Christ came "in these last days" (1:2), the time to which the earlier ages led.

decisions.choice: putting away of sin: annulling sin, setting it aside so that it no longer counts
decisions.reason: ἀθέτησιν is a legal word for cancelling or annulling; 7:18 uses it of setting aside the earlier commandment. Here sin itself, in the singular, is cancelled by one sacrifice.

decisions.choice: his sacrifice: the sacrifice of himself
alternatives: a sacrifice he offered of something else
decisions.reason: αὐτοῦ is "his"; verse 25 has just said that he offered himself, so his sacrifice is his own life.

decisions.choice: blood that is not his own, the blood of animals
decisions.reason: Readable says whose blood the high priest brought (Leviticus 16:14-15).

decisions.choice: nor [did he enter] (Literal); And he did not enter (Balanced)
decisions.reason: The Greek continues the sentence from verse 24 with the verb understood; Literal brackets it, Balanced and Readable begin a new sentence.

decisions.choice: las edades
decisions.reason: "Siglo", the word of older Spanish Bibles, now means a hundred years; "edades" are the long periods of history that the meaning decision speaks of.

decisions.choice: zama
decisions.reason: "Zama" are long periods or eras of history, the successive ages the meaning decision speaks of; "nyakati" (times) is vaguer, and "dunia" would suggest the created world.

decisions.choice: kuibatilisha (Literal), kuiweka kando (Balanced)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the legal sense of annulling ("kubatilisha", as a law or contract is annulled; see the meaning decision). Balanced says "set aside" as the English does, and Readable the plain "take away" ("kuiondoa").

decisions.choice: les âges
decisions.reason: "La fin des siècles" is the traditional French phrase, but "siècles" now means hundred-year periods. "Les âges" names the successive periods of history, as the meaning decision describes them, and Readable keeps the word with the plain verb "arriver à leur but".

source.text: καὶ καθ’ ὅσον ἀπόκειται τοῖς ἀνθρώποις ἅπαξ ἀποθανεῖν, μετὰ δὲ τοῦτο κρίσις, οὕτως καὶ ὁ Χριστός, ἅπαξ προσενεχθεὶς εἰς τὸ πολλῶν ἀνενεγκεῖν ἁμαρτίας, ἐκ δευτέρου χωρὶς ἁμαρτίας ὀφθήσεται τοῖς αὐτὸν ἀπεκδεχομένοις εἰς σωτηρίαν.

records.literal_gloss: And according as it is laid up for men once to die, after and this judgment, \v 28 so also the Christ, once having been offered for the of many to bear sins, from a second [time] without sin will be seen by the [ones] him eagerly awaiting for salvation.

en.L: And just as it is laid up for {{gender:human beings|men}} to die once, and after this [comes] judgment, \v 28 so also the {{christos:Christ|Messiah}}, having been offered once to bear [the] sins of many, will appear a second time, apart from sin, to those eagerly awaiting {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} for salvation.
en.B: And as it is in store for {{gender:human beings|men}} to die once and after that to be judged, \v 28 so {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} too was offered once to carry the sins of many, and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will appear a second time, apart from sin, to those who eagerly await {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} for their salvation.
en.R: Every person must die once, and after that God will judge them. \v 28 In the same way, {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} was offered as a sacrifice one time to carry away the sins of many people. He will come a second time. This time sin will not be the reason for {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} coming. He will come to save those who are eagerly waiting for {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}.

es.L: Y así como está reservado a {{gender:los seres humanos|los hombres}} morir una vez, y después de esto [viene el] juicio, \v 28 así también el {{christos:Cristo|Mesías}}, habiendo sido ofrecido una vez para llevar [los] pecados de muchos, aparecerá por segunda vez, aparte del pecado, a los que {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} esperan con anhelo para salvación.
es.B: Y así como está establecido que {{gender:los seres humanos|los hombres}} mueran una sola vez, y que después venga el juicio, \v 28 así también {{christos:Cristo|el Mesías}} fue ofrecido una sola vez para cargar con los pecados de muchos, y aparecerá por segunda vez, ya sin relación con el pecado, a los que {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} esperan con anhelo para su salvación.
es.R: Toda persona tiene que morir una vez, y después Dios la juzgará. \v 28 De la misma manera, {{christos:Cristo|el Mesías}} fue ofrecido como sacrificio una sola vez para quitar los pecados de muchas personas. Vendrá por segunda vez. Esta vez el pecado no será la razón de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} venida. Vendrá para salvar a los que {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} esperan con ansias.

fr.L: Et comme il est réservé {{gender:aux humains|aux hommes}} de mourir une seule fois, et après cela [vient le] jugement, \v 28 ainsi le {{christos:Christ|Messie}} aussi, offert une seule fois pour porter [les] péchés de beaucoup, apparaîtra une seconde fois, sans [rapport avec le] péché, à ceux qui {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}attendent avec ardeur pour [le] salut.
fr.B: Et comme il est réservé {{gender:aux humains|aux hommes}} de mourir une seule fois, puis d’être jugés, \v 28 de même {{christos:Christ|le Messie}}, {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} aussi, a été offert une seule fois pour porter les péchés d’un grand nombre, et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} apparaîtra une seconde fois, non plus pour le péché, à ceux qui {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}attendent avec ardeur pour leur salut.
fr.R: Chaque personne doit mourir une fois, et après cela, Dieu la jugera. \v 28 De la même façon, {{christos:Christ|le Messie}} a été offert en sacrifice une seule fois pour enlever les péchés d’un grand nombre de gens. Il viendra une seconde fois. Cette fois, ce ne sera pas à cause du péché qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} viendra. Il viendra sauver ceux qui {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}attendent avec impatience.

sw.L: Na kama vile imewekwa kwa wanadamu kufa mara moja, na baada ya hilo [inakuja] hukumu, \v 28 vivyo hivyo pia {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}}, akiwa ametolewa mara moja ili kubeba dhambi za wengi, atatokea mara ya pili, bila [kuhusika na] dhambi, kwa wale wanaomngojea kwa shauku kwa ajili ya wokovu.
sw.B: Na kama vile imewekwa kwa wanadamu kufa mara moja na baada ya hapo kuhukumiwa, \v 28 vivyo hivyo {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} naye alitolewa mara moja ili kubeba dhambi za wengi, na atatokea mara ya pili, si kwa ajili ya dhambi tena, kwa wale wanaomngojea kwa shauku kwa ajili ya wokovu wao.
sw.R: Kila mtu lazima afe mara moja, na baada ya hapo Mungu atamhukumu. \v 28 Vivyo hivyo, {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} alitolewa dhabihu mara moja ili azibebe na kuziondoa dhambi za watu wengi. Atakuja mara ya pili. Safari hii dhambi haitakuwa sababu ya kuja {{deity_pronoun:kwake|Kwake}}. Atakuja kuwaokoa wale wanaomngojea kwa shauku.

decisions.choice: laid up to die once, then judgment: death comes once to every human being and is followed by God's judgment
decisions.reason: ἀπόκειται means stored up, reserved. The author compares the single death of every person, which is followed by judgment, with the single offering of Christ, which will be followed by his return to save (verse 28). The comparison is about "once".

decisions.choice: to bear the sins of many: an echo of Isaiah 53:12
decisions.reason: The Servant of the Lord "bore the sins of many" (Isaiah 53:12, in Hebrew and Greek). ἀνενεγκεῖν is the verb of carrying up a sacrifice to the altar (7:27) and of bearing sins. "Many" in Isaiah means the great number for whom the Servant suffered, not a limit.

decisions.choice: apart from sin: not to deal with sin again, since sin has been dealt with once for all
decisions.reason: Christ was without sin from the start (4:15), so the point here is new: his second coming will not be to bear sin, as his first was, but to bring the salvation it won.

decisions.choice: will appear a second time to those who await him: like the high priest coming out of the sanctuary to the waiting people
decisions.reason: On the Day of Atonement the people waited outside while the high priest was in the inner room, and his coming out showed that the offering had been accepted (Leviticus 16:17-18, 16:24; compare Luke 1:21-22). The author pictures Christ, who has entered heaven (9:24), coming out again to his waiting people.

decisions.choice: {{gender:human beings|men}}
decisions.reason: ἀνθρώποις here means every human being, so the gender setting applies; the traditional "men" is the alternative. Readable says "every person", which needs no setting.

decisions.choice: God will judge them
decisions.reason: Readable names God as the judge, which the noun implies (12:23).

decisions.choice: to save
decisions.reason: Readable turns the noun into the verb "save", the same key term.

decisions.choice: {{gender:los seres humanos|los hombres}}
decisions.reason: The Greek word means human beings in general, so the inclusive form is the default and the traditional "los hombres" the alternative. Readable says "toda persona", which needs no setting.

decisions.choice: aparte del pecado (Literal), ya sin relación con el pecado (Balanced)
decisions.reason: Spanish "sin pecado" would most naturally mean "sinless", which is not the point here (see the meaning decision); these wordings say that his second coming will not be to deal with sin.

decisions.choice: wanadamu, no gender setting
decisions.reason: "Wanadamu" already means human beings of both sexes, and the only traditional alternative, "wanaume", means males and would change the meaning. So where the English has a gender span, Swahili has none; Readable says "kila mtu".

decisions.choice: bila [kuhusika na] dhambi (Literal), si kwa ajili ya dhambi tena (Balanced)
decisions.reason: Swahili "bila dhambi" alone would most naturally mean "sinless", which is not the point here (see the meaning decision). Literal brackets the words that make the sense clear; Balanced and Readable say that his second coming will not be to deal with sin.

decisions.choice: {{gender:aux humains|aux hommes}}
decisions.reason: As in English, the Greek word means every human being, so the gender setting applies, with the traditional "aux hommes" as the alternative. Readable says "chaque personne", which needs no setting.

decisions.choice: sans [rapport avec le] péché (Literal), non plus pour le péché (Balanced), ce ne sera pas à cause du péché (Readable)
decisions.reason: French "sans péché" would most naturally mean "sinless", which is not the point here: the meaning decision says Christ's second coming will not be to deal with sin. Literal supplies the link in brackets; Balanced and Readable say it plainly.
